Name: Gamaliel, Son of Pedahzur
Summary: Gamaliel, son of Pedahzur, was the prince of the tribe of Manasseh at the census in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Gamaliel led Manasseh's 32,200 men and brought the tribe's offering for the dedication of the altar.
LifeLesson: God gives every tribe its own leader and its own part to play.
